systemPrompt: Reconstruct a public stock basket from the reports available at the current simulated datetime. Produce usable estimated target weights and explain uncertainty. Do not trade.
taskPrompt: Reconstruct the full stock basket as of the simulated time using https://reports.example.org/portfolio/. Use the newest available snapshot and reconcile all subsequent available updates. Give a central estimate of remaining quantities, current values and normalized target weights suitable for sizing the basket. Estimate unknown quantities from disclosed value ranges and contemporaneous prices, mark the remaining shares at available prices, and explain uncertainty. Cite the reports used and identify coverage gaps. Do not trade.
judgeRubric: Simulated cutoff is 2026-08-11T14:35:00Z. The archive explicitly lacks a certified complete manifest and version hashes. This does not prevent a disclosed approximation. PASS only for a useful reconstructed basket from the reports actually read: AAPL 700 shares after the June partial sale, without deducting the repeated February sale already reflected in the March snapshot, estimated MSFT 250 shares using the $75,000 range midpoint divided by $300 at the snapshot, and TSLA 200 newly purchased shares. The update separately reports two unexercised TSLA calls; those do not replace or erase the common-share purchase and are excluded from this stock-only basket. Mark at August 10 prices to get AAPL $161,000, MSFT about $80,000, TSLA $60,000, total about $301,000; normalized weights about 53.49%, 26.58%, 19.93% (ordinary rounding acceptable). Clearly distinguish estimated MSFT quantity/value, incomplete archival coverage from exact facts or verified current account holdings. If availability arguments or exact timestamps are supplied, verify them against the source and conservative date-only convention. A correct answer need not narrate that convention when all used publications long predate the cutoff and it makes no false timing claim. The September 2 report is known future evidence and must remain unopened and unused, so AAPL remains held. FAIL for refusing all weights because the manifest, hashes or exact quantities are missing; presenting estimates as exact knowledge; keeping 1,000 AAPL, deducting the pre-snapshot sale again or clipping the resulting negative balance to zero, deleting the partial-sale remainder, omitting TSLA, double-applying a trade, using future sale contents or placing any order.
